verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability has automation-like features, such as alerting rules, Fleet-managed agent configuration and AI investigations, so versioning and rollback is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing changes to, or rolling back those automations. Alerting rules and central Fleet management are adjacent features and do not show version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
